content.content:
1. Applicability. The check is applied to the dependent as recorded. A dependent whose content is a placeholder, or which records no element at all, offers nothing to read against its prerequisites: the check fails as not applicable, naming the subject and the reason, and it does not pass for want of a contradiction. Until the dependent records what it decides, the gate is not satisfied.

2. License, applied once per prerequisite in depends_on: no element of the dependent contradicts that prerequisite — read as the prerequisite is recorded, and where a prerequisite carries a ref'd artifact, read together with that artifact. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element and the prerequisite it departs from.

The criterion names no element of either side and no wording of the dependent; which element is at issue is found while reading the dependent against each recorded prerequisite, and it appears only in the finding. It demands no behaviour — a prose dependent buys no observables — and it survives a rewording of the dependent that leaves what it decides unchanged.
content.rationale:
The dependent is one commitment in prose, held inline, and its three prerequisites do not all sit on one row of the matrix: qrqsxyzz is prose held inline, while tvtnokzu carries `specs/drafts/state.qnt` and wrvsxwmq carries `schemas/work.json`. The child column is natural — the dependent's content is readable prose — so the qrqsxyzz edge takes the natural-to-natural cell exactly, and the two artifact-carrying edges land on the default cell: wrvsxwmq is code (the matrix names schemas as code), and tvtnokzu is a spec document read as its own form, structured at the loosest reading and code where the model is machine-checked. Every one of those cells prescribes the same gate form, so the criterion does not turn on which of them a given edge takes; natural-to-structured prescribes the identical licence check, so even a child read as requirement sentences would be gated the same way. The two default cells are flagged for a matrix entry: a natural child of an artifact row has no file of its own, and the matrix's default is the row's only guidance.

One evaluation covers all three edges because the dependent settles one thing and leans on the three at once. A base entry is a value determined by a path's content and by nothing else, with its encoding deliberately left unfixed (qrqsxyzz); a content identity is an opaque value the record carries rather than the algorithm that makes it (tvtnokzu); and the schema leaves every base entry unconstrained because the entry's value space belongs to the model (wrvsxwmq). Those three are the elements a dependent in this position can contradict, and they differ per prerequisite, which is why the licence pass is applied once per prerequisite in depends_on rather than once overall.

The check is licence and nothing more: it reads the dependent against each recorded prerequisite and fails on a contradicting element. Nothing runs — there is no artifact in the dependent to execute and no observable to probe, and a prose dependent buys no licence to demand behaviour. Applicability is stated first because licence over an empty element set passes for want of a contradiction: a dependent that has not yet recorded what it decides has no element set to read, so the check fails as not applicable until it does, which is how this form is red before the dependent exists. Where a prerequisite carries a ref'd artifact, the check reads that artifact with the prerequisite, so what an element is measured against is the artifact's recorded text and not a paraphrase of it.

The criterion names no element of either side in advance and tracks no wording of the dependent: which element is at issue is what the check discovers at check time, and it is named in the finding. It invents no rule the prerequisites do not state, restates no part of the dependent, and presupposes no later decision: the encoding and the record's form are read from the prerequisites as recorded, never supplied by this gate.
